detaileddescription.para: X-macro blocks expand into inline constants across four views (ID, IDref, IDtag, IDtype). All categories are combined into a single MAKE_VIEW invocation per view — adding a new category means adding its X-macro block here, not redefining MAKE_VIEW.
Keys already present in jam::ID are excluded — they are available globally.
